historical_references.context: Basili was the name of a Christian ruler of the Rhodos region in the eastern Mediterranean, who entered into a treaty with the Muslim conqueror Muawiya I (661-680) to secure peace and autonomy for his subjects. Basili provided military support to the Muslims during their campaigns against the Byzantine Empire.

historical_references.context: Basili was the name of a Mamluk Sultan of Egypt, who ruled during the late 13th century. He is best known for his successful campaigns against the Mongols in Syria and Palestine, which prevented their advance into the heart of the Islamic world.
